name: iwdg_example
description: IWDG_Example: TIM5's channel 4, remapped onto LSI (TIM5_OR), measures LSI (32 kHz) and the IWDG is set to 250 ms from it (/32, reload LSI / 128); the main loop toggles LD2 and refreshes it every 240 ms. B1 at 1 s makes the EXTI handler write an invalid address: the hard fault's loop stops the refreshes, the IWDG resets the part about 250 ms later, and the program, finding IWDGRSTF, lights LD1.
